telegrams.body: THE OWNERS HAVE INSTRUCTED US TO CALL AT HAKODATE BEFORE PROCEEDING TO KOBE THE MASTER CAN ACCEPT THE NEW ORDERS PROVIDED THAT THE REQUIRED CHARTS AND BUNKERS ARE SUPPLIED PLEASE CONFIRM THAT THE VOYAGE ORDERS AND NEW AGENCY DETAILS ARE FINAL
